how_to_use.title: Find the corner
how_to_use.text: Each industry is compared with the average industry over 6 months (ahead or behind) and over the last month (gaining or slowing). The two answers put it in one of four corners.

how_to_use.title: Read the corner with breadth
how_to_use.text: Broad means most of the industry's stocks are above their 50-day average; Narrow means a few carry it. A broad lead has held up better than a narrow one.

how_to_use.title: Watch the rank and its moves
how_to_use.text: The rotation rank puts every group on one list each week. The arrows show the places it moved in 1 and 4 weeks.

how_to_use.title: Corners describe the past
how_to_use.text: A corner says how an industry has done, not what it will do. It is not a reason to act on its own.

disclaimer: Describes past prices of NSE industry groups against the average industry. Not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security.
